newsitem.title: USA: MAPCO unit buys Wilcox Propane.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO unit buys Wilcox Propane.

text.p: MAPCO Inc said Monday that a retail propane business unit had acquired an independent retailer based in Greenbrier, Arkansas.
MAPCO said the unit, Thermogas, had bought Wilcox Propane Co Inc for an undisclosed sum.
It said the acquisition was part of a strategy to expand into target markets where Thermogas had the potential to become a leading retailer.
Thermogas markets propane through 23 outlets and satellites in Arkansas, it said.
Wilcox markets propane to 1,500 customers in central Arkansas and has annual sales of 650,000 gallons, it added.
MAPCO markets natural gas liquids, propane and refined petroleum products.
